label: Solana Yield and DeFi Optimization
summary: This cluster focuses on simplifying decentralized finance through automated yield aggregation, lending platforms, and user-friendly savings tools primarily built on the Solana blockchain.

representativeProjects.name: SolFi Lending Platform
representativeProjects.oneLiner: A user-friendly Solana lending platform featuring dynamic interest rates, real-time risk monitoring, and seedless onboar

representativeProjects.name: HiveFI
representativeProjects.oneLiner: A DeFi platform providing simplified access to optimized yield-generating strategies.

representativeProjects.name: Carrot
representativeProjects.oneLiner: Automated yield aggregator using value-accruing liquid tokens to optimize DeFi returns directly in user wallets.

representativeProjects.name: SolNest
representativeProjects.oneLiner: A simplified DeFi savings platform on Solana offering high yields and easy withdrawals.

representativeProjects.name: Sol YieldHunter
representativeProjects.oneLiner: Automated yield aggregator and optimizer for Solana DeFi protocols with risk-managed rebalancing.
